name: Truth Universally Acknowledged - Seasilk Heart
source:
Talay, a recently transformed merperson, has to navigate a new life under the sea. Depending on your choices, Talay could find love, become a renowned dressmaker or save the oceans from a threat of mass destruction. With nothing but the passion for dressmaking, how far could Talay go?

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/4072110/Truth_Universally_Acknowledged__Seasilk_Heart/]Steam[/url]]
translation:
塔莱是最近转变的人鱼，必须在海底开始新的生活。根据你的选择，塔莱可以找到爱情，成为著名的裁缝，或者拯救海洋免受大规模破坏的威胁。除了对裁缝的热情，Talay能走多远？

[来自[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/4072110/Truth_Universally_Acknowledged__Seasilk_Heart/]Steam[/url]]
